claim: § The monodromy matrix + Stability boundaries: stability is where multipliers sit against the unit circle, and the kind of crossing (+1, −1, complex pair) sets the kind of bifurcation, each with its own audible signature.

pieces.what: Multiplier plane with the unit circle; drag (a, q) and watch the two multipliers move, collide on the real axis and leave.
Hear the crossing: below, at and above threshold, the period-doubling case at audio rate.
pieces.walks_up_from: a damped tone with no pump

pieces.what: The Bloch/Floquet figure laid beside the two equations it compares.
The Kapitza pendulum: a statically unstable inverted pendulum held up by shaking its pivot.

note: The bundle holds only hero and icon; the material lives in the parent project, tracked.
